generate_datapoints_from_asts: generate datapoints from AST JSON-lines files using the generate_data.py CLI tool
run_generate_data_cli: run generate_data.py with --ast_fp to parse ASTs and write output datapoints to a file
configure_context_count: configure the number of contexts per datapoint using the --n_cli argument in generate_data.py
extract_dfs_from_ast: extract DFS traversals from AST nodes using the get_dfs utility function
separate_datapoints_by_context: separate datapoints into context windows using the separate_dps utility function
